strategies.name: premarket_level_breakout_or_retest_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Mark the pre-market high and low from 3:00 a.m. EST to the 9:30 a.m. open on the 5-minute chart. Enter in the direction of a clean break above the pre-market high or below the pre-market low either on the lower-timeframe breakout candle close with elevated volume, or on a later retest of that broken
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry candle / below the breakout or retest support-resistance area. Target at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trail the stop to break-even or into profit and scale out as the move extends.

variants.variant_label: Lower-timeframe breakout entry with volume confirmation
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter on a clean close above/below the level with elevated volume
variants.target_note: minimum 1R; ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trail and scale out
variants.transcript_quote: when that two-minute breaks out above that London high or where to break down below London low, we want to see the break and we actually want to see,ص

variants.timeframe_note: 5-minute pre-market levels, with lower-timeframe execution implied
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to pull back to the broken level and hold it as support/resistance before entering
variants.target_note: minimum 1R; ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trail and scale out
variants.transcript_quote: if you wanted to wait for a retest of this level, you would simply look for price to pull back down into this previous high over here, make it support

strategies.name: premarket_level_liquidity_sweep_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: When price briefly breaks above the pre-market high and fails back below it, or breaks below the pre-market low and quickly reclaims it, enter in the opposite direction of the failed break after the reclaim/confirmation. The setup is a fake breakout or stop run that reverses back through the level.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry candle. Target at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trim, move the stop to break-even or into profit, and trail the remainder as long as the reversal continues.

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct executable skeletons: continuation on a true break/retest of the pre-market level, and reversal on a liquidity sweep/failure of that level. Breakout and retest are grouped as compatible entry variants on the same continuation skeleton because they share the same directional thesis and management.
